# Bounded card renderer fixtures

These unchanged approved overlays cover six reviewed cards, their eleven runtime rarity variants and five blank frames. Their original SHA-256 values remain in `assets/source/cards/handoff-v1/cards.json`. The tests reuse already shipped public portraits and previews instead of duplicating paintings here.

This bounded set preserves production pixel comparisons and frame-tamper checks without requiring the private multi-gigabyte artwork archive. The complete artist kit, editable sources and all other overlays are restored separately with `EVERFOLK_ARTWORK_DIR`. Frame symbol and font credits are retained in `licenses/`; full shipped credits remain under `public/assets/cards/collection-v14/` and `public/fonts/`.
